description: Product registry: which Products the Marketing Engineer serves, their gates, and the read-only locations of each Product's repository and Go-To-Market Package. It records where strategy lives, never the strategy itself.
path_resolution: A local path starting with ~/ resolves against the home directory of the account running the Marketing Engineer. On a machine with a different layout, set the environment variable named in a location's env field to an absolute path; it replaces that location's default. Paths inside Mandu are relative to the resolved Mandu checkout.

products.name: Immerse

gate.condition: RepToday's first 14-day window ran cleanly and the Founder confirmed it in Mandu; until then nothing runs for Immerse, and after it Immerse gets Listening only.

products.go_to_market_package_note: Immerse has no Go-To-Market Package yet. Its Listening Evidence feeds Immerse's naming decision and a future package in Mandu through package-change proposals.
